Lead came in via blog post about RAG for contract search. SMB legaltech focused on contracts and precedent search. They spun up a test account and pushed ~5k PDF-derived docs using our quickstart; initial embeddings look reasonable. Primary ask: reusable hosted-api flow that writes embeddings to managed Pinecone (they are testing Pinecone and Milvus) and then use a small reranker model to improve precision on close-match clauses.

Customer quotes: "We need high-precision clause-level answers — often 1-2 sentence snippets — and we can tolerate a 150-300ms extra latency for reranking". Cost sensitivity: wants guidance on embedding dimensionality, batching recommendations, and cost per 1k queries.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO for admin console, audit logging for who queried what. Data residency: US-only preferred but not strict. They asked whether Redwood hosted API supports native connectors to Pinecone or if they should run ingestion pipelines themselves. Also asked about tokenization differences across model variants and recommended reranker sizes.

POC ask: produce runbook showing end-to-end flow (hosted embeddings -> Pinecone -> query + rerank) with sample code and an estimated cost profile for 10k monthly queries. They are likely to stay SMB but could expand to Dedicated if SLA & data residency constraints tighten.
